chunks: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام disliked that the polytheist be fed from the meats of the sacrificial animals.

key_terms.الْأَضَاحِيِّ: the sacrificial animals offered as udhiyah
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكُ: the polytheist; one who associates partners with Allah
key_terms.وَكَرِهَ: he disliked; indicates legal reprehensibility rather than absolute prohibition

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to give the meat of sacrificial animals to polytheists according to Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal dislike concerning giving the meat of sacrificial animals to a polytheist. It reflects adab and fiqh related to the distribution of udhiyah meat within the Islamic framework.
